text: The Patriots are leaning heavily on second-round linebacker Gabe Jacas to anchor the defense this week against Jacksonville, with the rookie already making impact plays through two weeks and ready to start in Week 3 despite the unit facing some serious personnel losses. On the injury front, it's been a rough go: the team ruled out OLB Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and rookie LB Quintayvious Hutchins (knee), with Hutchins subsequently placed on injured reserve, while TE Eli Raridon (thigh) and S Craig Woodson (shoulder) are both questionable for Sunday; however, there's a silver lining with CB Carlton Davis III set to return and Raridon showing positive signs in practice. To bolster their depth, the Patriots elevated S Mike Brown and DT Jeremiah Pharms Jr. from the practice squad, giving the roster some reinforcement as they attempt to right the ship before a Jaguars team that's expecting to capitalize on New England's still-developing identity. The coaching staff has also identified an area of concern that transcends the injury report: the team must improve their clock management late in the second quarter, as questionable halftime decisions in their first two games have compounded an already challenging start to the season.
